thread:
Aisha Khan: customer ACME (tenant_id=acme-42) reports console shows 0s for hourly usage from 2024-02-05 02:00 -> now (~5h). Ticket INC-4521. Can we triage?
Mike (support): thanks — can you paste a quick repro SQL or screenshot? any error in console?
Aisha Khan: screenshot attached in ticket. repro SQL: select * from hourly_usage where tenant_id='acme-42' and ts >= '2024-02-05 02:00' order by ts desc; returns zeros. No console errors, just missing rows.
Ben (analytics): looking at ingest pipeline — I see CDC connector spikes at 2024-02-05 01:58 UTC then consumer group "usage-ingest-v2" stalled. offsets frozen.
Ben (analytics): kafka consumer log snippet: \n```\n2024-02-05T01:59:03Z ERROR CommitFailedException: NotLeaderForPartition for topic usage-events partition 12
2024-02-05T02:01:17Z WARN Consumer paused for 00:00:00.005 to rebalance
```\nSRE Oncall: did leader election/rebalance happen around then? I see a controller election in cluster-4 at 01:58:50 UTC.
airflow-bot: dag hourly_rollup run 2024-02-05T02:00 FAILED (task: write_hourly) — retry 1 scheduled.
Ben (analytics): manifest processor that lists S3 data for that window didn't find objects for that tenant between 02:00-03:00 because the CDC consumer hadn't committed those offsets. So ETL skipped those keys and wrote zeros.
Mike (support): can we rerun just that tenant's backfill for the missing windows? customer is seeing dashboards blank.
SRE Oncall: plan: 1) restart consumer group tasks for usage-ingest-v2 on node pool beta-ingest-2 (need safe drain), 2) trigger airflow backfill for hourly_rollup for ts 2024-02-05T02:00-2024-02-05T07:00 for tenant acme-42, 3) monitor console. I'll do (1) now.
SRE Oncall: restart done, consumers rejoined, lag draining. current lag: partition 12 -> 0, partition 7 -> 12 messages.
Ben (analytics): kicked off targeted backfill: `airflow dags backfill hourly_rollup --start-date 2024-02-05T02:00 --end-date 2024-02-05T07:00 --conf '{"tenant_id":"acme-42"}'`
airflow-bot: backfill started for hourly_rollup (6 runs).
Aisha Khan: ran repro SQL 4m ago, I see rows populated for 02:00-05:00 but 05:00-07:00 still pending. Customer updated ticket: appreciates quick action.
Mike (support): good. please keep me posted when all windows populated and I'll close INC-4521 or escalate if not.
SRE Oncall: set pager suppression and increased consumer max.poll.interval.ms to avoid small rebalances while we investigate underlying broker flakiness. Logging an ops follow-up ticket OP-789 to check controller flaps.
Ben (analytics): follow-up: root cause looks like transient broker leader flip during a rolling upgrade; recommend soft-rolling broker update windows and better consumer commit retries.
Aisha Khan: thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll update customer with ETA ~30m.
Mike (support): marking thread in support as in-progress, will close after final verification.
